name: Messaging app
summary: A messaging app on a phone: chats as rows with a tinted initial, the last line, the time and unread counts; a thread with grouped bubbles, day separators, a photo, a voice note and the read state; a composer above the home indicator that rides up with the keyboard. From 768px a sidebar, the list and the thread side by side. Onboarding, loading, empty and error states.
anatomy: Welcome (drawing, one sentence, Continue with my number) → Chats: large title with New, search, rows with unread counts → Thread: back and name, day separators, grouped bubbles, photo, voice note, read state, composer → People: search and rows → Settings: grouped settings
type: humanist: friendly, open letters that read well at 17px in a bubble
motion: No scroll moments. A thread opens at its newest message; a sent message joins your run of bubbles.
